From the manufacturer
Hawkins Classic Pressure Cooker
The Classic is Hawkins’ range of pressure cookers - perhaps because of its attractive combination of features benefits. This range was to be introduced by Hawkins and has been kept up to date by numerous innovations and improvements over the years. The improvement introduced , is a superior pressure regulating system that controls pressure to a narrower, more range, reduces sprouting of frothy foods (such as dal) and is easier to insert and remove.
About Us
Hawkins Cookers Limited has been in business since 1959. It is in the pressure cooker market in India and has exported its products since 1974 to various countries in each of the six continents of the world.
Mission:
We have one overarching goal: to win over customers, to truly please them by delivering products and service beyond their expectations, to earn their friendship and build relationships that will endure.

Customers say
Customers find the pressure cooker easy to use and consider it good value for money. The cooking performance and durability receive mixed feedback - while some say it works efficiently, others report issues with the cooker not working and safety valves breaking within months of use. Moreover, the lid design is problematic as it's hard to close and open, and the size receives mixed reviews with some finding it suitable for large meals while others note the separators are too small. Additionally, customers report leakage problems, with water spilling during use.
